en.headline: Police arrest 51 in New Territories South anti-crime sweep
en.dek: Operation Ragingstorm over Friday and Saturday targeted bars, game centres and vehicles across Sha Tin, Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, Lantau and the airport district.
body: Police in New Territories South arrested 51 people aged 18 to 90 during an anti-crime operation codenamed Ragingstorm on 11 and 12 September, according to accounts carried by HK01 and Oriental Daily citing the Force.

Officers from the regional operations, crime and traffic formations and the drone team worked with Sha Tin, Kwai Tsing, Tsuen Wan, Lantau and airport district units. They set up roadblocks to check vehicles and inspected bars, amusement game centres and other premises.

Those detained included local and Mainland residents as well as Pakistani, Indian, Indonesian and Filipino nationals, police said. They are suspected of offences including unlawful assembly, dangerous driving, failing without reasonable excuse to provide a breath specimen, operating a gambling establishment, gambling in a gambling establishment and breaching conditions of stay.

Police said dangerous driving and refusing a breath test are serious offences that can carry a fine of up to HK$25,000 and three years’ imprisonment, as well as driving disqualification. Operating a gambling establishment can attract a fine of up to HK$5 million and seven years’ jail under the Gambling Ordinance. Officers said enforcement against similar activity would continue.

zh.headline: 新界南「熾風」反罪惡行動拘51人
zh.dek: 警方於9月11至12日在沙田、葺青、荃灣、大嶼山及機場一帶設路障並巡查酒吧機舖，涉嫌罪行包括危駕及賭博。
body: 新界南總區警方於9月11及12日展開代號「熾風」的反罪惡行動，拘捕51名年齡介乎18至90歲的人士，香港01及東方日報引述警方報道。
行動由總區行動部、刑事部、交通部及無人機隊聯同沙田、葺青、荃灣、大嶼山及機場警區進行，人員在區內多處設路障檢查可疑車輛，並巡查酒吧、遊戲機中心及其他目標處所。
警方表示，被捕人士包括本地及內地居民，以及巴基斯坦、印度、印尼及菲律賓籍人士，分別涉嫌非法集結、危險駕駛、無合理辯解而沒有提供呼氣樣本、經營賭博場所、在賭場內賭博及違反逗留條件等。
警方指，危險駕駛及拒絕提供呼氣樣本最高可判罰款2.5萬元及監禁3年，並可取消駕駛資格；根據《賭博條例》，經營賭博場所最高可判罰款500萬元及監禁7年。警方稱會繼續針對相關罪行執法。
